text: If you eat instant oatmeal in the mornings, make a swap for 7 days: green buckwheat (you can cook it in advance for 2–3 days) + a piece of butter + a pinch of salt and a little greens. This is simple “earthy” food without unclear industrial processing. It gives steady energy, your blood sugar swings less, and it miraculously reduces anxiety. And the most important ingredient is your attention! When you eat this buckwheat, do not expand your attention beyond the edges of the plate. Feel the taste of what you are eating.
